justification: The only meaningful overlap is that both surfaces include schematized human or anthropomorphic content: A shows a single frontal face on an upright form, while B includes small human/anthropomorphic figures or body-like elements among its reliefs. The biggest difference is that B is a crowded, tiered animal-and-symbol composition with birds/quadrupeds/serpentine forms and repeated signs, whereas A’s decoration is essentially one isolated frontal face with no comparable animal iconography or banded narrative arrangement.
